registered_before: any normalised, persistence or terrain-filtered result was computed or viewed; the whole-patch cloud mask (satellite-0.3 item) is folded into this version
status: exploratory method development on the 129 Pipeline B events; unknown-region scan only if the registered threshold is met
question: Do (a) change features normalised by the pre-event variability of the same pixels, (b) persistence of the change in a second post-event image, and (c) a terrain / water / cloud-buffer filter improve the held-out rediscovery of documented landslides and reduce false candidates per km2 compared with satellite-0.2?
primary_endpoint: held-out rediscovery with logistic regression (unit-held-out): number of events whose documented position is found within 160 m among the first three candidates, and candidates per km2; satellite-0.2 reference: 28 of 129 events, 4.49 candidates per km2 (reports/satellite/heldout_discovery_results.json)
secondary_endpoint: unit-weighted within-group AUC of the event-held-out baseline (change_features vs change_norm), with a paired unit bootstrap for the difference
decision_rule: A variant is called better only if the paired unit-bootstrap interval of the within-group AUC difference excludes zero; the discovery counts are reported as counts with the number of independence units (15) and no significance claim. All variants and filters are reported, none is selected after the fact.

normalisation.pre_delta: idx(before_primary) - idx(before_reference) for idx in ndvi, nbr, bsi, brightness, on valid pixels of both scenes
normalisation.sigma_core: std of pre_delta inside the 320 m core box, floored
normalisation.sigma_ring: std of pre_delta inside the ring (960 m box minus core), floored
normalisation.sigma_scene: 1.4826 * MAD of pre_delta over the whole patch, floored

features.z_core_<idx>: (core mean of delta - ring mean of delta) / sigma_core
features.frac_z_below_<idx>: share of core pixels with (delta - median(delta)) / sigma_scene < -2 (box filter), sign flipped for bsi and brightness so that 'below' always means a change away from the before state in the loss direction

normalisation.missing_reference: no before_reference for the sample (or insufficient valid pixels): the normalised features are missing (NaN), counted and reported; no fallback value is invented

persistence.persistence_<idx>: a1 = small_contrast(after_primary - before_primary), c1 = small_contrast(after_confirm - before_primary); sign(a1)*min(|a1|,|c1|) if sign(a1) == sign(c1) else 0
persistence.missing_confirm: after_confirm missing or not usable for the sample: persistence and regrowth features are NaN, counted and reported (gradient boosting handles NaN, logistic regression imputes the training median)
persistence.controls: for a control the reference / confirm acquisition is the positive's acquisition on the tile covering the control (same minute and collection, usable by the local quality rules); otherwise missing

filters.terrain_source: V0.4 30 m Skadi window of the event (read only, pre-event verified), slope sampled at the candidate pixel
filters.cloud_source: union of cloud-like / snow / invalid pixels (SCL classes above and the NDSI snow rule) of before_primary and after_primary over the whole 2.56 km patch
filters.rule: a peak is removed if slope < min_slope_deg, or water share in its 320 m core >= max_water_core_share, or it lies within cloud_buffer_m of the cloud mask; removed peaks are counted by reason; the search centre keeps its priority for the hit definition only through the same filters (a documented event on a gentle slope is then a miss, not an exception)

discovery.unchanged: stride, peak distance, hit radius 160 m, suppression of other known positives 160 m (config/satellite.json)

position_refinement.purpose: the only allowed feedback to Pipeline A: a coordinate proposal with provenance, never a feature
position_refinement.event_selection: rediscovered events (hit within 160 m) whose change persists (persistence_ndvi < 0 or persistence_bsi > 0 at the hit pixel)
position_refinement.scar_mask: contiguous region of pixels with d_ndvi < -0.15 or d_bsi > 0.1 or d_brightness > 0.05 (satellite.json thresholds) that contains or is nearest to the hit pixel within 160 m, clipped to a 640 m window
position_refinement.output: old position, new position (mask centroid), distance, area, source = satellite_scar_centroid, source position class
position_refinement.check: distribution of the shifts by source position class; any event with a shift > 50 m in a class with an upper bound <= 5 m is listed for questioning the source or the centroid, never overwritten automatically

stage6_unknown_region.condition: executed only if satellite-0.4 reaches, with the all-filters variant, >= 50 % of the 129 events found within 160 m among the first three candidates AND <= 2 candidates per km2; otherwise not executed and reported as not reached
stage6_unknown_region.region: one Styrian storm footprint (2023-08) without the known events; status of every candidate UNVERIFIED

staging: 1 event -> 5 events -> 20 events -> all; cache every patch; GDAL crashes are handled by re-running the cached stage
interpretation_limits: 15 independence units; Sentinel-2 revisit and cloud cover limit the pairs; the documented position is itself uncertain (<= 20 m class); candidates are not landslide labels; harvest, construction and forestry mimic scars
